description: Labeled sentence pairs for calibrating the two-stage semantic validator. label=1 means meaning is preserved (a rewrite that SHOULD pass validation); label=0 means meaning has been altered (a rewrite that SHOULD be rejected). Hand-labeled, not AI-generated.
